prompt: Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Use Spectrum 1-4: page #F9F9FB, text #251F2D, accent #861D85, secondary surface #EFEAE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Composition: Large event title, date and venue, then an unframed program table and direct booking action. Use body 14px, heading 48px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
